chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from 'Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) cursed ten [people] regarding wine: its planter, its keeper, its seller, its buyer, its drinker, the consumer of its price, its presser, its carrier, the one to whom it is carried, and its server.
ai.seo_question: Who are the ten people cursed regarding wine in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the ten categories of individuals cursed by the Prophet for their roles in the wine trade, establishing a comprehensive legal framework that extends beyond mere consumption to include cultivation, storage, sale, and serving. In Shia jurisprudence, this enumeration underscores the severity of khamr by attributing a specific curse to each link in the supply chain, thereby validating the prohibition of all associated activities. The listing reflects the Prophetic tradition's emphasis on collective responsibility in ritual purity and legal compliance.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Salim, from Ahmad Bin Al Nazar, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> cursed regarding the wine, ten – Its planter, and its keeper, and its seller, and its buyer, and its drinker, and the consumer of its price, and its presser, and its carrier, and the one is it carried to, and its quencher (server)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from ‘Amr ibn Shamir from Jabir who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has condemned because of wine ten characters. Of such characters is the planter, the keeper, the seller, the buyer, the drinker, the payment receiver, the squeezer, the carrier, the one being carried to and the server of wine.’”
